US Political Parties Eye Post-Trump Era and AI Compromise

As the United States political landscape shifts, both Republican and Democratic parties are reportedly looking towards a post-Donald Trump era. Discussions are emerging about potential areas of compromise, particularly concerning Artificial Intelligence (AI), with some Democrats expressing a willingness to work with Trump on specific issues. Additionally, a "nuclear trilateral" concept is being discussed as a potential early test of Trump's influence following an election.
